items.text: “Bobo da, naikorokoraata akwap araun airumet koroet, iinanakinete EJAKAIT ainakinet, atutubet nakalaunan naka akwap: aojauke ikubitin ilukumin akaisaarei ka lukany, alalauke da ikubitin iluktunin itomon: eraun nakalaunan kowaitinike kere airimor.
Ejaun nen aibois nakalaunan, aoiauke ikubitin akwat akany, alalauke da ikubitin akwat akany, ariakanara; ka ikubitin akaisakany kanuka ironyia airimor.
Kaitemisioit na itemi aoiau naka ikubitin ilukumin akaisaarei ka lukany, ka alalau naka ilukumin itomon: tomake ejaun aibois nakalaunan, naerai nakalaunan noi.

Erai atutubet nakalaunan naka akwap; eraun naka isasedotin, ikeiaanakinak luka aibois nakalaunan, luikunyakinete aijaanakin EJAKAIT: eraun aibois naka itogoikec, ka aibois nakalaunan kanuka aibois nakalaunan.
Ido Ilebin, ikeiaanakinak lukotogo, ejaunos ka ikubitin ilukumin akaisaarei ka lukany aoiau, ka ikubitin ilukumin itomon alalau, araut alupokee, kanuka ireriakee luiboienenoto.
“Igitarete alup nuka ere ikubitin ilukumin ikany alalau, ka ikubitin akaisaarei ka lukany aojau, kidunyakina kainakinet naka atutubet nakalaunan: eraunos nuka ekek kere loka Isirael.

“Ido nuka ekapolon ejaunete epuwai ka epuwai kainakinet nakalaunan, ka alup nuka ere; kowaitin luka ainakinet nakalaunan, kowaitin da luka alup nuka ere, kariino nukokide ka nukoto: eriakanara aoiau atutubet adiopet, anyoun kari nakoto kiton ari nakokide.
Eraunos alupoke kotoma akwap naka Isirael. Kwabo mam bobo ikapolokoka emwanete ikatuŋa; konye einakinete ekek loka Isirael akwap kwape ejaatar atekerinikec.
“Inera kwanata Ejakait EDEKE ebe: Kodaut, yes ikapolok luka Isirael! Kolemasi akaje ka aiŋat, kitodoloto etube ka adolit: ebala Ejakait EDEKE ebe, Kinyeis aireŋear ikatuŋa,
Koraas epa ka akaalakany nuka aitemisioit adiopet, edoli akaalakany yenikitomonet yenika ekomer

epa da yenikitomonet yenika ekomer: aitemisioitike koiaun kwape eiaar ekomer.
da eriakas igeran akaisaarei: isekelin ikany eraunos isekelin ikany, isekelin itomon eraunos isekelin itomon, ka emanekus kes isekelin akaisakany.
Na ŋes ainakinet naiinanakinete; idiopet kokanykape yenika epa yenelemunio kazjolikomer loka enano, iinanakinete da idiopet kokanykape yenika epa yenelemunio kanolikomer loka esairi:

ka ainakinet naicorakinitai naka akinyet, naka akaalakany naka akinyet, eraun idiopet kotomon yenika akaalakany yenelemunio kokor, kes akaalakanya atomon, kes ekomer; naarai akaalakanya atomon kes ekomer:

ka imerekek idiopet yenikosipan yenelemunio kakwat aarei, koronyia lukecoa luka Isirael. Ebala Ejakait EDEKE ebe, ŋin ŋes ainakinet naka akiria, ka ainakinet naicweio, ka ainakineta nuka ainapakin, alueio kes.
Einanakinete ituŋa kere luka akwap ainakinet nin kanuka ekapolon loka Isirael.

Eraun aswam naka ekapolon ainakin ainakineta nuieweio, ka ainakineta nuka akiria, ka ainakineta numatan, kopuein, ka nailamununia elap, kasabaton, kopuein kere lueseunitai luka ekek loka Isirael: ŋes itemonokini ainakinet naka adiakaret, ka ainakinet naka akiria, ka ainakinet naicweio, ka ainakineta nuka ainapakin, alucio ekek loka Isirael.
“Inera kwanata Ejakait EDEKE ebe: Kolap losodit, kapaaran nasodit naka elap, iyanaari emoŋ lotobait lomam eŋwalit; kitesegia aibois nakalaunan.
Elemuni esasedoti aokot nuka ainakinet naka adiakar, ejuki ategerio nuka etogo, ka agoria aoŋon nuka amurut naka etem, ka ategerio nuka erute loka alaro nakotoma.
Ido iswamaenenei kwaŋin kapaaran nakikanyetekaarei naka elap, kanuka ŋinituŋanan yenepaari, kaŋin da yenijimat: kwaŋin ilucenenoto etogo.
“Kolap losodit, kapaaran nakitomonet kaonon naka elap, kojaununos kAleleŋio, epueit loka apaarasia akanykaarei; kes enyamere imugatin lumam itubuunitoi.
Kapaaran kaŋin itemonokini ekapolon emoŋ lotobait araun ainakinet naka adiakaret kanuken, kanuka ituŋa da kere luka akwap.

Itemonokini ŋesi ainakinet naicweio mama ejai EJAKAIT apaarasia akanykaarei nuka epueit, imoŋin lutoba ikanykaarei, ka imerekekin ikanykaarei lumam eŋwalito ninipaaran adaun apaarasia akanykaarei; ka ekoroi da ŋinipaaran araut ainakinet naka adiakaret.
Ido itemonokini ainakinet naka akiria, epa ediopet kaŋolimon lotobait, ka epa ediopet kanolimerekek, ka ekin

Kolap lokikanyetekaarei, kapaaran nakitomonet kakany naka elap, kopueit, kiswamaenenei kwape kwaŋin adaun apaarasia akanykaarei: kwape ejaar ainakinet naka adiakaret, ka ainakinet naicweio ka ainakinet naka akiria, ka naka akinyet, kwape ejaatar.
